label: Zendesk
description: Sync customers and their orders to Zendesk users, and open tickets for failed payments, cancellations, refunds and returns. In Zendesk Admin Center → Apps and integrations → APIs → OAuth clients, add a confidential client and copy its identifier and secret.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the OAuth client and the Swell user fields in Zendesk

actions.label: Create user fields
actions.hint: Adds the Swell order fields to Zendesk user profiles

actions.label: Import existing customers
actions.hint: Creates or updates a Zendesk user for every customer account

modal.title: Import existing customers
modal.description: Creates or updates a Zendesk user for every customer account with an email, using the current settings. Runs in the background; large stores can take several minutes.

fields.label: Zendesk subdomain
fields.description: The first part of your Zendesk address, e.g. acme for acme.zendesk.com

fields.label: OAuth client identifier
fields.description: The client's Identifier in Zendesk Admin Center → Apps and integrations → APIs → OAuth clients

fields.label: OAuth client secret
fields.description: Shown once when you save a confidential client

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off everything the app sends to Zendesk without uninstalling it

fields.label: Customers
fields.description: Swell customers become Zendesk users, matched by their Swell account ID and email.

fields.label: Sync customer accounts
fields.description: Creates or updates a Zendesk user when a customer account is created or changed

fields.label: Show orders on Zendesk users
fields.description: Keeps order count, total spent, last order and recent orders on the user. Run Create user fields once.

fields.label: Recent orders to show
fields.description: Number of latest orders in the Recent orders field

fields.label: Tickets
fields.description: Opens a Zendesk ticket for the customer when one of these happens. The ticket starts with an internal note, so the app doesn't email the customer; your Zendesk triggers still apply.

fields.label: Ticket tags
fields.description: Comma-separated tags added to every ticket, next to one for the event, e.g. swell_payment_failed

fields.label: Group ID
fields.description: Zendesk group that gets the tickets. Empty: your default group.
